question: What's the best rate on this page?
reply:
The lowest rate on the page is the 2-year fixed rate for owner occupiers: 5.79% (comparison rate 6.44%), from the Example Lender page read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time.

If "best rate" should instead mean the lowest variable rate, that's 6.04% p.a. (comparison rate 6.07% p.a.) for LVR 60% or less.

Note: this page was true when read; if it's being relied on later, it should be checked again for current figures.
